Role Overview
The Junior Data Analyst supports business and operational decision-making by collecting, organizing, analyzing, and interpreting data. It is designed for early-career professionals who are developing their analytical skills and gaining practical experience with data-driven processes.

• Collect, clean, and organize data from multiple sources.
• Review datasets to identify errors, inconsistencies, or missing information.
• Perform basic data analysis to identify trends and patterns.
• Prepare reports, summaries, and dashboards to support business decisions.
• Assist in maintaining data accuracy and quality standards.
• Support the creation and improvement of recurring reports.
• Work with internal teams to understand data requirements.
• Document analytical processes, findings, and reporting methods.
• Assist with ad-hoc data requests and business analysis tasks.
• Contribute to improving data workflows and reporting efficiency.
Qualifications and Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
• Basic understanding of data analysis concepts and statistical principles.
• Familiarity with spreadsheets, databases, and reporting tools.
• Ability to organize and interpret large amounts of information.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
• Basic knowledge of data visualization concepts is an advantage.
• Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving abilities.
• Ability to work independently and collaborate with team members.
• Good communication skills and ability to present findings clearly.
• Internship experience, academic projects, or practical data work is beneficial.
Summary
The Junior Data Analyst plays an important role in supporting data-driven operations by ensuring information is accurate, organized, and useful. This position provides hands-on experience with analysis, reporting, and business insights while offering a strong foundation for career growth in data analytics and related fields.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Analyst Level 2 will play a key role in driving data-driven decision-making for our department and organization. The Product Analyst 2 will focus on analyzing product performance, generating insights from data, and supporting decision-making to optimize product offerings. They are expected to blend data analysis with a strong understanding of product development and performance metrics. In this role, the Product Analyst 2 will work to streamline reporting processes, work with stakeholders to define dashboard requirements, ensure data quality and continuously improve reporting systems for the team. In this role, the individual is expected to independently handle the development of data-driven solutions that influence decision-making across the organization. The role requires a comprehensive understanding of various business aspects, which helps in turning data into useful insights for the business and provider management department.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Reporting:
Perform in-depth data analysis to identify trends, insights, and product opportunities that can improve performance.
Create and deliver ad hoc reports and dashboards for various stakeholders, ensuring timely and accurate data delivery.
Ensure all reporting and analysis adheres to best practices for data quality, integrity, and consistency.
Develop, maintain, and enhance product reporting systems to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and other critical metrics.
Reporting Logic & QA:
Develop and document reporting logic, ensuring that all calculations, data aggregation, and transformations are clearly defined and validated.
Perform Quality Assurance (QA) testing on reports and dashboards to ensure data accuracy and consistency across platforms.
Review and validate data and reporting assumptions with stakeholders to ensure alignment with business needs.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Management:
Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and provide data-driven insights.
Assist the department and teams in developing new product features or modifications by providing insights based on data analysis.
Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure dashboards and reports align with business goals and provide meaningful insights.
Continuous Improvement:
Continuously improve reporting processes, ensuring they are efficient and scalable to meet evolving business needs.
Stay current with new features and capabilities in Power BI, and other tools, applying new techniques to improve reporting and dashboard development.
Identify opportunities to develop new dashboards and products that improve product insights and drive better decision-making.
Power BI Dashboards:
Collaborate with business stakeholders to define requirements for new dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Power BI.
Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards that allow stakeholders to quickly access and understand key product data.
Work with the Data analytics team to develop new Qlik dashboards, ensuring they meet user requirements and are scalable for future needs.
Write detailed documentation for reporting logic and dashboard functionalities.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business, Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics).
5 years of experience in a product analytics, data analysis, or similar role, with a focus on reporting and dashboard development.
Strong Proficiency in SQL and Python with the ability to extract, transform and analyze large datasets, write reusable functions, troubleshoot errors and optimize queries and scripts.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to write complex formulas, apply logical and statistical functions, and create dashboards.
Proven experience in developing, documenting, and QA'ing reporting logic for complex datasets and KPIs.
Extensive experience with Power BI to build, maintain, and optimize dashboards and reports.
Experience working in a product-driven or technology-driven company.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and cross-functional collaboration.
Capable of working with stakeholders to evaluate potential risks and translate business requirements into layman’s terms.
Knowledge of additional reporting and data visualization tools.
Experience in automating reporting processes and improving operational efficiency.
Demonstrated experience in designing user interfaces with a focus on information delivery.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to draw insights from data and present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to ensuring data accuracy and consistency across reports and dashboards.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights in a clear and concise manner.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Work includes conducting needs assessments, providing information and referrals, coordinating service delivery across external partner organizations, and offering career navigation to support successful employment and workforce outcomes for local employers. The Talent Network Coordinator plays a key role in strengthening talent pipelines, improving access to services, and aligning community workforce efforts with the City’s economic development priorities.

Preferred Benefits

etwe

Eligibility to purchase prior service credit under the Defined Benefit Plan

Employee Benefits webpage.

Provide information, referrals, and warm handoffs to OED programs and community workforce partners.
Deliver career coaching and navigation, including follow-up communication to ensure successful connections and outcomes.

Support businesses in identifying workforce needs and connecting them to appropriate OED programs, community training programs and talent resources.

Identify gaps in services and recommend improvements to enhance access and outcomes.

Assist in planning and implementing workforce events, workshops, and hiring initiatives.
Build and maintain relationships with employers, training providers, and community organizations.
Promote OED workforce programs and services to jobseekers and businesses.

Provide high-quality, responsive customer service to diverse populations, including individuals with barriers to employment.
Collaborate with internal staff and external partners to coordinate services and share information.
Resolve concerns and provide guidance to improve user experience and service delivery.

Regular and reliable attendance.

Required to successfully pass a pre-employment background check and pre-employment drug screen.

Job Summary

The Analyst Level 2 will play a key role in driving data-driven decision-making for our department and organization. The Product Analyst 2 will focus on analyzing product performance, generating insights from data, and supporting decision-making to optimize product offerings. They are expected to blend data analysis with a strong understanding of product development and performance metrics. In this role, the Product Analyst 2 will work to streamline reporting processes, work with stakeholders to define dashboard requirements, ensure data quality and continuously improve reporting systems for the team. In this role, the individual is expected to independently handle the development of data-driven solutions that influence decision-making across the organization. The role requires a comprehensive understanding of various business aspects, which helps in turning data into useful insights for the business and provider management department.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Reporting:
Perform in-depth data analysis to identify trends, insights, and product opportunities that can improve performance.
Create and deliver ad hoc reports and dashboards for various stakeholders, ensuring timely and accurate data delivery.
Ensure all reporting and analysis adheres to best practices for data quality, integrity, and consistency.
Develop, maintain, and enhance product reporting systems to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and other critical metrics.
Reporting Logic & QA:
Develop and document reporting logic, ensuring that all calculations, data aggregation, and transformations are clearly defined and validated.
Perform Quality Assurance (QA) testing on reports and dashboards to ensure data accuracy and consistency across platforms.
Review and validate data and reporting assumptions with stakeholders to ensure alignment with business needs.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Management:
Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and provide data-driven insights.
Assist the department and teams in developing new product features or modifications by providing insights based on data analysis.
Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure dashboards and reports align with business goals and provide meaningful insights.
Continuous Improvement:
Continuously improve reporting processes, ensuring they are efficient and scalable to meet evolving business needs.
Stay current with new features and capabilities in Power BI, and other tools, applying new techniques to improve reporting and dashboard development.
Identify opportunities to develop new dashboards and products that improve product insights and drive better decision-making.
Power BI Dashboards:
Collaborate with business stakeholders to define requirements for new dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Power BI.
Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards that allow stakeholders to quickly access and understand key product data.
Work with the Data analytics team to develop new Qlik dashboards, ensuring they meet user requirements and are scalable for future needs.
Write detailed documentation for reporting logic and dashboard functionalities.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business, Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics).
5 years of experience in a product analytics, data analysis, or similar role, with a focus on reporting and dashboard development.
Strong Proficiency in SQL and Python with the ability to extract, transform and analyze large datasets, write reusable functions, troubleshoot errors and optimize queries and scripts.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to write complex formulas, apply logical and statistical functions, and create dashboards.
Proven experience in developing, documenting, and QA'ing reporting logic for complex datasets and KPIs.
Extensive experience with Power BI to build, maintain, and optimize dashboards and reports.
Experience working in a product-driven or technology-driven company.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and cross-functional collaboration.
Capable of working with stakeholders to evaluate potential risks and translate business requirements into layman’s terms.
Knowledge of additional reporting and data visualization tools.
Experience in automating reporting processes and improving operational efficiency.
Demonstrated experience in designing user interfaces with a focus on information delivery.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to draw insights from data and present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to ensuring data accuracy and consistency across reports and dashboards.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights in a clear and concise manner.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

General Summary

The Talent Network Coordinator
within the Office of Economic Development
performs responsible, professional, administrative, and relationship-centered work coordinating talent connection services for jobseekers and businesses within the Charlottesville workforce ecosystem. This position serves as a workforce navigator utilizing a “no wrong door” approach, ensuring individuals and employers are connected to the most appropriate resources, programs, and opportunities within the community.

Work includes conducting needs assessments, providing information and referrals, coordinating service delivery across external partner organizations, and offering career navigation to support successful employment and workforce outcomes for local employers. The Talent Network Coordinator plays a key role in strengthening talent pipelines, improving access to services, and aligning community workforce efforts with the City’s economic development priorities.

Primarily and most frequently the work done here is performed independently and reports to Workforce Development Program Manager.

Preferred Benefits

The preferred hiring amount for this position is b
etwe
en
$65,757.80 - $79,182.91 Annually.
Starting offer is based on applicable education, experience, and internal equity. This full-time, exempt position offers a comprehensive benefits package, including 13 paid holidays plus one floating holiday, vacation and sick leave, health insurance with employer contribution, employer-paid life insurance, gym membership reimbursement, tuition assistance, and professional development opportunities. This position is also eligible for the following retirement benefits:

Choice of retirement plan:
Defined Benefit Pension Plan: Provides a monthly benefit upon retirement, calculated using a defined formula based on earnings history, years of service, and age. The plan includes a 5-year vesting period and requires an employee contribution of 5% of salary.
Defined Contribution 401a Plan: Employer makes fixed contributions to an individual account, which are invested, and returns are credited to the account. The account balance is used to provide retirement benefits. Vesting occurs at 33% after one year, 67% after two years, and 100% after three years of service. No salary contribution is required.

Voluntary 457 Deferred Compensation Plan
Eligibility to purchase prior service credit under the Defined Benefit Plan

The City of Charlottesville manages its own retirement system and does not participate in VRS; however, a Portability Agreement is available for eligible employees. For additional details, please refer to the “Benefits” tab within this posting or visit the City’s
Employee Benefits webpage.

Essential Responsibilities And Duties

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations will be considered to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The essential functions of the job are not limited to those listed in the job description. The City retains the discretion to add to or change the duties of the position at any time.

Workforce Navigation & Case Management

Serve as a central point of contact for jobseekers and businesses seeking workforce support using a no wrong door model.
Conduct assessments to identify employment, training, hiring, and workforce needs.
Provide information, referrals, and warm handoffs to OED programs and community workforce partners.
Deliver career coaching and navigation, including follow-up communication to ensure successful connections and outcomes.
Assist jobseekers with resume development, job search strategies, and interview preparation.
Support businesses in identifying workforce needs and connecting them to appropriate OED programs, community training programs and talent resources.

Program Coordination & Service Delivery

Coordinate and implement workforce services, ensuring alignment with OED programs and regional workforce initiatives.
Maintain knowledge of workforce training programs, education pathways, and support services available in the community.
Collaborate with workforce partners to streamline referrals and improve service delivery.
Identify gaps in services and recommend improvements to enhance access and outcomes.

Data Tracking, Reporting & Evaluation

Track and maintain accurate data on individuals served, businesses assisted, referrals made, and outcomes achieved.
Utilize databases and tracking systems to monitor performance metrics and service effectiveness.
Develop monthly and annual reports summarizing program activity, outcomes, and impact.
Analyze trends and data to inform program improvements and strategic decision-making.

Outreach, Events & Employer Engagement

Represent OED at career fairs, community events, and workforce-related meetings.
Assist in planning and implementing workforce events, workshops, and hiring initiatives.
Build and maintain relationships with employers, training providers, and community organizations.
Promote OED workforce programs and services to jobseekers and businesses.

Customer Service & Collaboration

Provide high-quality, responsive customer service to diverse populations, including individuals with barriers to employment.
Collaborate with internal staff and external partners to coordinate services and share information.
Resolve concerns and provide guidance to improve user experience and service delivery.

Other Duties

Responsible for appropriate use and maintenance of City equipment, tools and other resources, including work time.
Regular and reliable attendance.
Performs additional duties to support operational requirements as apparent or assigned.

Education, Experience And Skills

Education and Experience:
Candidates may qualify by demonstrating the required knowledge and skills outlined for the job through experience(s) other than formal education.

Bachelor’s degree in a related field AND at least 2 years of experience in Workforce Development, Economic Development, Career Coaching, Human Resources, or Employer Engagement or related area.

OR

Associates degree in a related field AND at least 4 years of experience in Workforce Development, Economic Development, Career Coaching, Human Resources, or Employer Engagement or related area.

OR

High School Diploma or GED AND at least 6 years of experience in Workforce Development, Economic Development, Career Coaching, Human Resources, or Employer Engagement or related area.

OR

An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered in lieu of the specific requirements listed above.

Certifications/Licenses/Other Requirements

Must obtain and maintain a valid Virginia driver’s license and acceptable driving record according to city criteria.
Required to successfully pass a pre-employment background check and pre-employment drug screen.

Preferred:

Knowledge of local or regional workforce systems and community resources.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities And Other Characteristics

Job Knowledge

Knowledge of workforce development systems, employment services, and training programs.
Understanding of barriers to employment and strategies to support diverse populations.
Thorough knowledge of the principles, practices, processes, systems, conditions and/or support of and for the program participants.
Thorough knowledge of office administrative practices and of applicable Federal, State, and local regulations, policies, and procedures.
Knowledge of program management, workflow development, and quality assurance practices.
Knowledge of relevant internal and/or community partner agencies.
Knowledge of databases and other methods to track data, performance measurements, and maintain accurate records.

Reading

Intermediate: ability to read and understand regulations, policies, technical reports, journals, multi-step instruction manuals, and reference materials. Ability to research, compile, analyze, and interpret data, trends, and outcomes.

Writing

Intermediate: ability to organize data and write clear and concise reports, prepare business letters, explanations, and summaries with proper format, punctuation, spelling and grammar, using all parts of speech. Composes clear and accurate written communications including program SOPs, evaluation tools/findings, and written internal controls.

Math

Intermediate: ability to work with and understand number systems; simple formulas, practical application of fractions, percentages, ratios/proportions and measurement such as technical specifications, budget preparation and financial operations.

Communication Skills

Intermediate: Establish and maintain effective working relationships with co-workers, clients, customers, city officials, and others. Ability to effectively communicate, and recommend, program policies and procedures. Ability to present information and data to a variety of audiences. Contact that may involve stressful, negative interactions requiring high levels of tact and the ability to respond to aggressive interpersonal interactions. Elements of persuasion may be necessary to gain cooperation and acceptance of ideas. Delivers responsive and high-quality customer service.

Independence and Decision-Making

Requires Limited Direction: normally completes work according to their own judgment, requesting supervisory assistance occasionally. Special projects are managed with little oversight and assignments may be reviewed upon completion. Performance reviewed periodically.

Technical Skills

Skilled: comprehensive, practical knowledge of a technical field with use of analytical judgment and decision-making abilities appropriate to the assigned and apparent job responsibilities. Skill in the use of a variety of standard office machines and software packages. Intermediate skill in the use of Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, etc.) and ability to effectively use agency systems and software.

Fiscal Responsibilities

Completes research for documents, compiles data for computer entry, and/or enters or oversees data entry. Has responsibility for monitoring budget/fiscal expenditures (typically non-discretionary expenditures) for a program, activity, project or small organizational unit. May recommend budget allocations.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Lead Worker: Guides, instructs, provides direction, assigns, and monitors work of others. May evaluate, or provides input on, program staff performance and of program service delivery and needs.

Other Characteristics

Organization and time management skill, sometimes under strict time constraints.
Ability to exercise sound independent judgment and demonstrate tact, diplomacy, and professionalism.
Frequent change of tasks, interruptions and requests for service.
Performing multiple tasks simultaneously.
Working closely with others as part of a team.
Must work effectively with sensitive and confidential information or issues.
May require dealing with angry, frustrated and/or upset individuals.
May be required to work outside normal work schedule such as evenings, weekends, and/or holidays.

Physical Demands

Sedentary Work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally, and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. Remains in stationary position most of the time.
